questions.question: When Paul was sent by ship to Italy as a prisoner, who was put in charge of him?
While sailing to Italy as a prisoner, what did Paul warn the men the voyage would bring?

answers.text: Disaster and great loss even of their lives
A long delay but no real danger
A sickness spreading among the prisoners

questions.question: On Paul's voyage to Italy, what swept down across the island of Crete and caught the ship?

answers.text: A hailstorm like the one in Egypt
A thick fog from the open sea
